integrity: Formal combinatorial bijection proof and independently executed finite exhaustive direct enumeration of nineteen configurations; finite checks corroborate, not replace, the all-sizes proof. No independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: The classification counts only square-zero distance-preserving partial injections of complete multipartite finite graphs, not all nilpotents or general graph endomorphisms. Higher-index nilpotents and simplified maximal-rank formulas for arbitrary multipartite part sizes remain untreated. Full publication priority across all partial automorphism semigroup literature is unverified.
title: The complete square-zero rank distribution of multipartite partial-isometry monoids
